recentItems.title: Greater Noida Horror: 5 Family Members Die Under Mysterious Circumstances | Breaking News | ET Now
recentItems.description:
BREAKING NEWS: Five family members have been found dead under suspicious circumstances in Greater Noida.

According to the initial information, the family reportedly returned home around 10 PM and had Maggi and tea. Food poisoning is among the initial suspicions, but the cause of death has not yet been confirmed.

The bodies have been sent for post-mortem examination, and the report is awaited. What led to the deaths remains under investigation.

Watch this report for the details available so far as the investigation continues. The suspected cause should not be treated as confirmed until official findings are available.

recentItems.title: France Student Protests: School Anger Turns Into A National Political Crisis | Breaking News
recentItems.description:
PARIS UNREST: Police and students face off as protests continue across France.

Student-led demonstrations over teacher shortages, underfunded schools and poor facilities have spread beyond Paris, with some protests turning violent. Prime Minister Sébastien Lecornu has accused the radical-left party La France Insoumise (LFI) of exploiting the unrest for political purposes, an allegation the party disputes.

With France heading towards the 2027 presidential election, the protests have intensified debate over education, policing and the government’s response. Watch our report for the latest developments and the political context behind the unrest.

Follow Rahul Gandhi live, India Bloc protest live, anti-CEC protest updates, and the latest developments as opposition leaders raise concerns over electoral issues. Stay tuned for breaking political news, Delhi news, and all the latest updates on the CJP protest and the INDIA Bloc’s campaign demanding CEC resignation.
